  1. Given a declared model with an optional value, When it is emitted, Then the option maps to a nullable C# type and one generated spec using it passes (trait Slice=089)
  2. Given a nested record, When it is emitted, Then it maps to a record and one generated spec using it passes
  3. The repository gate passes with zero warnings
